Bundles

Two ways to bundle. The Trio puts one design on a sticker, a magnet, and a shirt for $5 less than the pieces bought separately. A Mix & Match Pack is any 3 stickers or magnets, all one size, at their regular prices added together.

The Trio — one design, three pieces

One design on a sticker, a magnet, and a shirt — the same design on all three pieces. Every Trio is $5 less than buying the three pieces on their own:

Small — 3″ sticker $4.50 + 3″ magnet $7.50 + shirt with design up to 8″ $26.50 = $38.50 bought separately$33.50Save $5
Medium — 4″ sticker $5.50 + 4″ magnet $8.50 + shirt with design up to 10″ $29.50 = $43.50 bought separately$38.50Save $5
Large — 6″ sticker $8 + 6″ magnet $10.50 + shirt with design up to 11.5″ $33.50 = $52 bought separately$47Save $5

The shirt size you wear (S to 3XL) is separate from the design sizes above — you pick it when you build your Trio. Shirt extras still apply: black shirt +$3, 2XL/3XL +$5.

Adding the three pieces to your order one by one instead? They combine into a Trio on their own, the $5 comes off automatically, and you can split them back apart in your order if you change your mind.

Build a Trio

Mix & Match Pack — any 3

Any 3 stickers or magnets, in any mix you like — three different designs, two stickers and a magnet, whatever suits you. All one size (3″, 4″, 5″, or 6″). The pack total is the regular prices of the three pieces added together — there’s no bundle discount on Mix & Match, so work out your pack from this table:

3″ pieces3 stickers $13.50 · 3 magnets $22.50
4″ pieces3 stickers $16.50 · 3 magnets $25.50
5″ pieces3 stickers $21 · 3 magnets $28.50
6″ pieces3 stickers $24 · 3 magnets $31.50

Mixing stickers and magnets? Add the pieces up one by one — for example, three 5″ magnets are $9.50 × 3 = $28.50, and two 4″ stickers plus a 4″ magnet are $5.50 + $5.50 + $8.50 = $19.50.

Build a Mix & Match Pack

One thing to know: pieces inside a Trio or a Mix & Match Pack don’t count toward the bulk discounts (stickers 25% off at 11 or more, magnets 10% off at 6 or more, shirts 5% off at 6 or more) — those discounts need the same design and size together in one order line.

How these prices compare: Checked against Sticker Mule, StickerGiant, StickerYou, Etsy, and Custom Ink in November 2026. One custom shirt at Custom Ink was quoted at $32.25. Single handmade pieces on Etsy run $4–$7 for a sticker, $7 and up for a magnet, and $25–$35 for a shirt. My prices sit in that same range, with no minimum — you can order just one.

    How ordering works

    1

    Build your order

    Pick a category or search the library — or upload your own artwork — then choose sticker, magnet, shirt, or car sticker, pick a size, and add it to your order. If the page reloads, your order is still here when you come back.

    2

    Check out & place your order

    At checkout you review your items, choose free shipping (just add your address) or pickup, and place the order — it opens a text or email to me with everything filled in. Attach your image file in the message if it’s your own design. I reply to confirm everything.

    3

    Pay after placing your order

    Paying comes after placing your order: use the PayPal or Cash App buttons at checkout — they’re always shown there with your total filled in (PayPal @Nwright1018, Cash App $nwright022290) — or pay by card or cash on pickup, as arranged when I confirm. Then I make your order.
